data.gender_notes: Kuvira is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kuvira is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘kuvera’, which means 'powerful' or 'mighty'. In Hindu mythology, Kuvira was the name of a demon queen who ruled over the Naga tribe. She was known for her immense power, intelligence, and cunning nature. The name Kuvira carries the meaning “Powerful queen” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kuvira usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful queen and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Kuvira belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Powerful queen.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kuvira total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
